observations.message: Primary call-to-action collides with hero copy on desktop.
observations.description: At 1440px width the CTA button overlaps the heading, obscuring the main marketing message.

observations.message: Footer contact link color fails contrast requirements against background.
observations.description: The contact link uses #5D9CEC on a light gradient, yielding a 2.1:1 contrast ratio.
observations.suggested_prompt: Apply a darker footer link color or background to meet at least 4.5:1 contrast.

observations.message: Mobile nav toggle lacks accessible name.
observations.description: Screen readers announce the toggle as 'button' with no label; aria-label should describe the action.
observations.suggested_prompt: Add aria-label="Open navigation" to the mobile menu toggle button.
